_meta.description: Phase 1 source registry for the K1 LLM-wiki workflow. Seeds spine sources plus existing guideline sources and records the first lightweight trust-gate policy. User-added sources begin from stat_edb_figures onward.

verified_allowed_if: official EDB URL or operator-confirmed official source
candidate_only_if: source is relevant but not yet operator-verified
source metadata is incomplete but worth tracking
blocked_if: cannot be tied to a stable source URL or document

verified_remains_if: last check shows no probable source change
no newer superseding version is known
review_required_if: a newer version or superseding document is detected

candidate_allowed_if: fact is linked to at least one source_id
topic and role scope are explicit
wording is traceable to the source meaning
publish_forbidden_if: fact conflicts with approved wording and has not been reviewed

auto_approve_if_all: value directly matches vault extract with no paraphrase
human_approval_required_for: fact_type = policy (詮釋性事實：角色責任、程序要求、門檻判斷)
any change affecting public contract interpretation
lighter_review_candidate_classes: obvious wording cleanup with unchanged source meaning
freshness confirmations with no content delta

must_not_do: rewrite trusted outputs directly from freshness alerts

sources.title: 教育局通函第221/2025號 —— 「『智』啟學教」撥款計劃
sources.title_en: EDB Circular Memorandum No. 221/2025 — Smart Teaching Funding Scheme (AI for Learning & Teaching)
sources.notes: 「『智』啟學教」撥款計劃：支援中小學善用人工智能提升學與教效能。教育局於 2025/1 成立「數字教育策略發展督導委員會」，2025 施政報告 QEF 預留 20 億元推進數字教育；本計劃成功申請學校獲一次過 50 萬元撥款，啟動及推動校本人工智能賦能教育（包括購置／訂閱／租用 AI 軟件／硬件／平台／資源、資助學生參加 AI 素養活動）。承諾要求：將「AI 賦能教育」項目納入學校發展計劃、最少 3 個科目／2 個級別推行 AI 輔助教學、發展 6 個 AI 教學例子、舉辦 3 次公開課／3 次經驗分享會／2 個學生活動。申請截止 2026/2/28、發款 2026/6/30、可跨學年用至 2027/28、財政紀錄保留 7 年。屬 digital_education route。
